name: Akiflow
description: Akiflow lets agents read and add tasks, plan the day, and check calendar events in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Akiflow account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is on my plan for today?
Add a task to review the contract draft on Friday morning.
Where do I have two free hours this week for deep work?

apps.name: Akiflow
apps.description: Task, calendar, and planning tools, over Akiflow's MCP server with browser sign-in.
